newsitem.title: ESTONIA: ESTONIAN INDUSTRIAL PRODUCTION UP 11.4 PERCENT YR/YR.
newsitem.headline: ESTONIAN INDUSTRIAL PRODUCTION UP 11.4 PERCENT YR/YR.

text.p: Industrial production in the first quarter of 1997 compared to the first quarter of 1996 rose by 11.4 percent, the statistics office said on Tuesday.
Industrial output increased the most in the textile industry with production 51.8 percent higher compared to the previous year.
Strong growth was also recorded in the processed timber industry with a 49.6 percent increase, and a 21.8 percent increase in rubber and plastics production.

Output fell in flour and cerial products production with a decrease of 41.6 percent and in tobacco products production with a decrease of 33.2 percent. --Tallinn newsroom +372 620 9202/1 reuters@reuters.ee
